headline: LAA @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 3.67 at TBR 3.36, with a projected total of 7.02. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved +0.40 runs while TBR moved -2.23, changing the projected margin by +2.62 runs. The projected total fell -1.83, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Nick Martinez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Junior Caminero, Yandy Díaz, Jonathan Aranda, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jose Siri because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
